files.label: file(name) gives the last file of a name, null for a name with only a value or without a part, and files() pairs each name with its files in request order (HY-113.2)
files.body:
--XyZ
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="f"; filename="a.txt"

first
--XyZ
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="t"

text
--XyZ
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="g"; filename="g.txt"
Content-Type: text/plain

third
--XyZ
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="f"; filename="b.txt"

second
--XyZ--

files.label: a file with an empty filename is the file of its name (HY-113.21)

u
--XyZ--

values.label: the raw query stops at the fragment, the pairs take each name once in the order of its first value, without nesting, and queryInt reads the last value (HY-56)
queryInt reads the last value of a repeated name, and the default for a name without a value (HY-56.5)
queryInt gives the default for a value of 16 digits and for a text, and the last value of a repeated name (HY-56.5)
queryInt gives the default for the digits 12 followed by a line feed (HY-56.5)
a target without `?` has an empty raw query and no query values (HY-56.1)
a target that ends with `?` has an empty raw query and no query values (HY-56.9)
the form values of a urlencoded body take each name once in the order of its first value, without nesting, and formString reads the last value or empty text (HY-57)
a text/plain body has no form values (HY-57.13)

a body whose type is application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8 gives form values (HY-57.14), and cookie(name) gives the first cookie of a name with its value percent-decoded (HY-129.13, HY-129.13)
cookie(name) finds the cookie named 1 and gives null for a name without a cookie (HY-129.13)
formString reads a text field of a multipart body and gives empty text for a name that has only a file (HY-57.13)

values.label: a multipart value of the byte ff under a quoted boundary is not valid input (HY-42.3, HY-57.13)
the query a[%FF][x]=1 is not valid input (HY-42.3)
the query a%FF[x]=1 is not valid input (HY-42.3)
the query a[b][c]=d is valid input (HY-42.3)
the query a=%ff is not valid input, and query() gives no pair for it (HY-42.3, HY-56.9)
the query a=%c3%a9 is valid input (HY-42.3)

the path /a%20b is valid input and is not decoded (HY-42.2, HY-42.3)
the form body a[b][%C3]=v is not valid input (HY-42.3, HY-57.13)
the form body a=%E2%82 is not valid input (HY-42.3, HY-57.13)
cookies are not checked: a request whose hy-keep and hy-session cookies are %FF is valid input, and each gives no cookie (HY-42.4, HY-129.13)

a body of 3 bytes with Content-Length x has the size 3 (HY-59.5)

a request created with a cookie map whose values are the byte ff, which no parse of a header gives, is valid input (HY-42.4)
a request without HX-Current-URL has no current path (HY-11.3)
a request whose selected type is application/vnd.hyper+json and that has HX-Request: true is a region request (HY-15.1)
a request that selects application/vnd.hyper+json without HX-Request is a JSON request and no region request (HY-15.1)
a request that selects text/html is no JSON request and no region request, also with HX-Request: true (HY-15.2)
wantsJson and isRegionRequest fail for a request that the server did not select, whose Accept header they do not read (HY-116.21)

withHeader returns a copy whose header of a name in another case has the new value and which holds a new header; the request itself is unchanged, and the copy keeps the method, the path, the raw query, the form values, the cookies, https and the selection (HY-97.4)

mediaType() fails with malformed_content_type (400) for an empty Content-Type, which is no media type, unlike a request without Content-Type (HY-59.13, MT-4.1)
